quoted_tweet.text:
At approximately 9:15 a.m. this morning, VicPD officers were responding to a priority call for service when a collision occurred at the intersection of Caledonia Avenue and Blanshard Street.

We are thankful to report that no members of the public were involved, no one was injured, and our officers are okay.

The intersection will remain closed for a period of time as reconstruction is conducted. We thank the public for their patience and ask drivers to avoid the area and seek alternate routes.

#yyj #news
